title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.21479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. translated_title: LynnReal-Hand：通过手部控制解锁世界交互
translated_abstract: 交互式视频世界模型可以通过文本和相机控制实现探索，但直接的对象交互需要更精细的控制。手部提供了一种自然的交互界面，但由于复杂的手-物体动力学和高要求的实时计算，将连续的手部动作转化为连贯的视觉响应仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了LynnReal-Hand，这是一个手部控制的视频世界模型，将精确的交互建模与高效的流式生成统一起来。我们精选了跨越多种真实和合成环境的10万个交互片段，并开发了手部感知监督来改进细粒度的手部动作和物体交互。在此基础上，我们学习了一个因果流图用于少步生成，并引入了区域感知分数蒸馏，结合互补的视频和图像先验来优化交互动力学和视觉外观。为了进一步降低推理（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: LynnReal-Hand是一个手部控制的视频世界模型，通过手部感知监督、因果流图和区域感知分数蒸馏三项创新，实现了精确的手-物体交互建模与高效的少步流式视频生成。
en_tdlr: LynnReal-Hand is a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise hand-object interaction modeling with efficient few-step streaming generation through hand-aware supervision, causal flow mapping, and region-aware score distillation.
